parse bulk string\n        if resp.startswith(b'$'):\n            idx = resp.find(b'\\r\\n')\n            length = int(resp[1:idx])\n            if length >= 0:\n                actual = resp[idx+2:idx+2+length].decode()\n            else:\n                actual = '(nil)'\n        else:\n            actual = resp.decode()\n        ok = b'ERR' not in resp\n        print(f'{desc} ({val}): resp={actual} -> {\"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\"}')\n    \n    s.close()\nfinally:\n    proc.terminate()\n    proc.wait()\nEOF\npython3 /tmp/test_float.py"}","name":"bash"},"id":"call_-7373350092834600062","index":0,"type":"function"}]}}],"created":1786052922,"id":"20260807054836e677915e83a1410f","model":"glm-5.2","object":"chat.completion","request_id":"20260807054836e677915e83a1410f","usage":{"completion_tokens":721,"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":0},"prompt_tokens":43120,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":42112},"total_tokens":43841}}
